author: Daniel Greene
description:
Oh no... America is doing an Animal Farm! George Orwell read humanity like a middle grade book. Let's unpack how Orwell used Napoleon the pig to skewer Stalin, and examine why the same patterns of power, propaganda, and betrayal keep showing up in modern politics — including Trump's America.
Animal Farm isn't just a classic. It's a manual.
